definition: Unique identifier assigned to each manuscript in the dataset.
notes: Primary key.

definition: Present repository holding the manuscript.
notes: Refers to the present holding institution, not the manuscript's place of production.

definition: Collection or subcollection in which the manuscript is held.
Shelfmark, call number, or equivalent repository identifier of the manuscript.
Title of the manuscript or work as represented in catalogue metadata.
Author attribution associated with the manuscript or work.
notes: Preserves catalogue attribution; authorship was not independently verified.

definition: Language description associated with the manuscript in the source data.
allowed_values: Free text; may contain legacy compound values
notes: Preserved as source/provenance data; normalized language relationships are represented in manuscript_languages.

definition: Genre or subject designation supplied by the catalogue.
notes: Preserves repository terminology.

definition: Normalized genre designation used to facilitate comparison across manuscript records.
notes: Not treated as a closed taxonomy.

definition: Script designation supplied by the catalogue.
notes: Preserves repository terminology.

definition: Normalized script designation used to facilitate comparison across manuscript records.
Page or foliation type information recorded for the manuscript.
notes: Preserves the convention used in the source data.

definition: Physical dimensions of the manuscript as reported by the source.
notes: Preserves source measurement conventions.

definition: URL of the principal online catalogue or repository record used for the manuscript.
URL of the IIIF manifest for the manuscript where available.
Catalogue or bibliographic reference associated with the manuscript.
Date on which the online source was consulted.
Additional manuscript-level information relevant to the dataset.
Unique identifier assigned to an individual colophon observation.
notes: Primary key.

definition: Identifier of the manuscript containing the colophon.
notes: Foreign key to manuscripts.

definition: Page or image label used to locate the colophon within the digital manifestation of the manuscript.
notes: Records digital pagination rather than the physical foliation of the manuscript.

definition: Folio or page location of the colophon as given in catalogue metadata.
notes: Preserves the catalogue's own foliation or pagination reference.

definition: Direct IIIF or image reference associated with the individual colophon observation.
Normalized language description retained from the original colophon annotation.
allowed_values: Legacy language value or compound value
notes: Retained for provenance; normalized relational language information is represented in colophon_languages.

definition: Functional classification of the colophon or completion statement.
notes: Controlled by SQL CHECK constraint.

definition: Name or designation of the scribe as represented in the individual colophon.
allowed_values: Free text; not stated where applicable
notes: Records what the individual colophon states rather than general manuscript attribution.

definition: Normalized form of the scribe's name or designation.
allowed_values: Free text; not stated where applicable

definition: Place of copying or completion as represented in the individual colophon.
allowed_values: Free text; not stated where applicable
notes: General manuscript provenance is not substituted for a place not stated by the colophon.

definition: Normalized form of the place stated in the colophon.
allowed_values: Free text; not stated where applicable

definition: Date of copying or completion as represented in the individual colophon.
allowed_values: Free text; not stated where applicable
notes: Preserves the formulation of the source where possible.

definition: Normalized representation of the date stated in the colophon.
Overall geometric configuration formed by the written text of the colophon.
allowed_values: rectangular; triangular; inverted triangular; inverted rectangular; inverted trapezoidal; trapezoidal; diamond; hourglass; circular-oval; irregular; no distinct shape; mixed
notes: Describes the geometry of the writing rather than the frame. Working analytical classification.

definition: Pattern created by the relative lengths of successive lines in the colophon.
allowed_values: equal; progressively shorter; progressively longer; shorter then longer; longer then shorter; mixed; single line
notes: Controlled by SQL CHECK constraint.

definition: Alignment classification assigned to the colophon text.
allowed_values: right; centered; left; justified; mixed; different
notes: Values reproduce the final SQL constraint.

definition: Relationship between the script used in the colophon and the script of the surrounding or main text.
notes: Controlled by SQL CHECK constraint.

definition: Ink colour or combination of colours observed in the colophon.
notes: Colour combinations are preserved where applicable.

definition: Whether a frame associated specifically with the colophon is present.
notes: Ordinary page or text-block framing is not automatically counted as a colophon frame.

definition: Geometric form of the frame associated with the colophon.
allowed_values: rectangular; triangular; circular-oval; irregular; other; trapezoidal; not applicable
notes: Describes the geometry of the boundary rather than the geometry of the written text.

definition: Presence and orientation of ruling within the colophon area.
notes: Ruling is treated separately from ornamentation.

definition: Decorative treatment associated with the colophon.
notes: Working analytical classification rather than an established taxonomy.

definition: Manner in which the colophon is spatially distinguished from the surrounding text.
Position of the colophon in relation to the principal text block.
notes: Controlled by SQL CHECK constraint.

definition: Spatial relationship between the colophon and marginal writing or material.
notes: Controlled by SQL CHECK constraint.

definition: Additional contextual or exceptional information concerning the individual colophon observation.
notes: Used for information not adequately represented by the structured analytical variables.

definition: Unique numeric identifier assigned to a normalized language.
notes: Auto-incrementing primary key.

definition: Normalized name of a language represented in the relational language model.
notes: Must be unique.

definition: Identifier of the manuscript associated with the language.
notes: Foreign key to manuscripts; part of composite primary key.

definition: Identifier of the normalized language associated with the manuscript.
notes: Foreign key to languages; part of composite primary key.

definition: Role assigned to the language in relation to the manuscript.
notes: For migrated slash-separated values, the language before / was treated as primary and the language after / as secondary.

definition: Identifier of the individual colophon associated with the language.
notes: Foreign key to colophons; part of composite primary key.

definition: Identifier of the normalized language associated with the colophon.
notes: Foreign key to languages; part of composite primary key.

definition: Role assigned to the language in relation to the colophon.
notes: For migrated slash-separated values, the language before / was treated as primary and the language after / as secondary.
